headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 6, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a thrilling 10-9 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Drake Baldwin leading the offense. The Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Washington Nationals 11-5, with Brandon Lowe's strong performance. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2, and the Minnesota Twins defeated the New York Yankees 6-1.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with notable players placed on the injured list. Brandon Woodruff, a right-hander for the Milwaukee Brewers, was placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. Tomoyuki Sugano, Seth Halvorsen, and Matt Gage also joined the injured list, with the Colorado Rockies, San Francisco Giants, and Milwaukee Brewers respectively. Ha-Seong Kim, Jakob Junis, and Evan Sisk were placed on the injured list by the Atlanta Braves, Texas Rangers, and Pittsburgh Pirates.

Several trades and roster movements occurred, including Ryan Degges being traded to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash. Tom Cosgrove was traded to the Washington Nationals for cash, and Kyle Nicolas was traded to the Washington Nationals for Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for Ben Hansen.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets outlasted the Atlanta Braves in a back-and-forth contest, ultimately securing a 10-9 win. Drake Baldwin led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, collecting 2 hits, including a home run, and driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense. Lowe's performance included a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2 in a closely contested game. Spencer Steer led the Reds' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Joe Ryan earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Woodruff Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The move was made on July 5, 2026.

top_news.title: **Degges Joins Guardians in Trade**
top_news.summary: Ryan Degges has been traded to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash. The move comes as part of a recent trade involving the Guardians.
